evals.name: new-changelog-from-history
evals.prompt: we don't have a changelog yet. can you make one from the git history?
evals.expected_output: A new Keep a Changelog CHANGELOG.md with an [Unreleased] section: the CSV export and widget.toml features under Added, the comma quoting fix and the non-conventional empty-config crash fix under Fixed; CI, test and chore commits left out. Not committed, no tag.
assertions: Features listed under Added (CSV export, widget.toml)
Fixes listed under Fixed, including the non-conventional crash fix
CI, test and chore commits left out

evals.name: update-since-last-tag
evals.prompt: update the changelog with what's landed since the last release
evals.expected_output: Adds the JSON export (Added), the ~ expansion fix (Fixed) and the streaming perf change (Changed) under [Unreleased]; leaves the 1.2.0 and 1.1.0 sections byte-identical; omits the CI-only commit; doesn't repeat already released entries.
assertions: New feature and fix added under Unreleased (JSON export, ~ in output_dir)

evals.name: breaking-footer-only
evals.prompt: add the recent changes to CHANGELOG.md
evals.expected_output: Both breaking changes are marked breaking under [Unreleased], in a callout or inline: the refactor marked only by a BREAKING CHANGE footer (environment overrides widget.toml) and the feat! removal of /v1/reports, each with the migration text from its footer. --quiet goes under Added.
assertions: Footer-only env-over-file change marked as breaking
Migration notes carried over from the footers

evals.name: cut-version-mismatch
evals.prompt: we're shipping 1.3.0 today, get the changelog ready for it
evals.expected_output: Writes a dated [1.3.0] section with the JSON export, the --out to --output rename (as breaking) and the ~ fix, keeps an empty [Unreleased] above it and updates the compare links. Points out that the breaking rename means SemVer calls for 2.0.0, but uses 1.3.0 as asked. Doesn't tag or bump package.json.
assertions: Flagged that the breaking change calls for 2.0.0 (notes.md)

evals.name: existing-conventional-format
evals.prompt: can you add the stuff since 1.2.0 to our changelog
evals.expected_output: Adds the JSON export under ### Features and the ~ fix under ### Bug Fixes, in the file's existing conventional-changelog style, above the 1.2.0 section. No Keep a Changelog headings.
assertions: New entries use the file's Features / Bug Fixes headings
No Keep a Changelog headings introduced

evals.name: release-please-managed
evals.prompt: please update the changelog with the latest changes
evals.expected_output: Notices release-please-config.json, explains that release-please writes CHANGELOG.md in its release PR, and leaves the file untouched.
assertions: Explained that release-please generates the changelog (notes.md)
